verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec, and the probe found that every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path returns 404. The runtime schema call returns data-model definitions with field types and relationships, not an endpoint spec, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
